title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 9
intro: Round 9 (2026-11-06). Your round-8 version is in the guide: the fixes and the music as you wrote them, the text of your check that read [Human Written, 0%](https://www.pangram.com/history/26e9138d-9b91-44e0-bb5c-7a21a7e4dddc). Your first two paragraphs stay as they were until you answer the card below.

Why the card had you editing only the second part: the box held all four paragraphs, but my card listed what to keep as the fixes and said I had kept your three lines as you wrote them, so the questions and the annoying-room line looked settled. They weren't; that pair had read AI in my check too. A card like that now gives each paragraph its own reading and says every one is yours to change.

What your fix showed is now in the shared rules for every lane: where you've asked for a guide's AI quips to go, your own lines that readers take for quips go too; the reason comes first, in plain words; and each instruction says its exact act, as "Ask if they'd like a hand on the shoulder" does.

The card is your exercise, the first part, which reads Human on its own. In place before your second part, the stretch reads AI, and so does the stretch as the guide has it now, all yours, so the stretch itself is the next work.

edits.before: Then look at the room. Is the light too bright? Is the music horrible? Are five concerned people talking at once? Is somebody touching the person when touch is unwelcome? Are they too hot, too cold, desperate for the bathroom, or trapped beside somebody they don't trust?
edits.after: A lot of what looks like a deep psychedelic crisis is a scared person in a room that's getting on their nerves, so look around the room next. Maybe the light's too bright or the music's horrible. Are five concerned people talking at once? Somebody might be touching them when they don't want it, or they're stuck beside someone they don't trust. And check whether they're too hot or too cold, or desperate for the bathroom.

edits.before: A huge amount of what gets called profound psychedelic crisis is a frightened nervous system stuck in an annoying room.
